summary: Adds a new file eval_queries.json for the debug-loop skill: a JSON array of 20 trigger-test cases. Each entry pairs a user query with a should_trigger boolean. Nine negative cases cover feature work, PR review, refactoring, TDD, cleanup, code explanation, lint fixes, brainstorming, and theory questions.
